Tim Culpan / Culpium :

Anthropic S-1: it spent just $482M on capex in H1 2026, leasing most of its compute, and its capex is almost entirely outsourced via $782B in lease obligations   —  What you need to know: Lease obligations pass $780 billion.  Revenue per employee $6.6 million  —  Good Evening from Taipei,
